sourceReview.reason: Six-hour retry hold: source searches on 2026-11-22 found no dated BlackRock primary statement or two independent full-text reports substantiating the attributed 0.01% share of global markets. BlackRock's August 4 release (https://www.blackrock.com/cash/en-ie/press-release-t4) concerns European tokenized money-market share classes and does not support this figure; the AFME 2025 tokenization report uses other market measures and does not attribute 0.01% to BlackRock. Three independently anchored facts for a new November announcement cannot be established. Original Google News discovery URL remains unresolved. Do not publish; retry no earlier than six hours after reviewedAt.
